name: dumbbell russian twist with legs floor off
description: A Russian twist with a dumbbell and your feet lifted off the floor. It strongly challenges the obliques and balance.
instructions: Sit down and lean back slightly with a dumbbell held in both hands.
Lift your feet off the floor with knees bent.
Rotate your torso to bring the dumbbell beside one hip.
Twist to the other side in a controlled way.
Keep your chest up and your back long.
